Reads an AudioMoth card: configuration, location and inventory

Source: R/read_audiomoth.R
read_audiomoth.Rd

Identifies the recordings of each daily folder with the data of the CONFIG.TXT file (device, sample rate, gain...) and with the metadata that AudioMoth writes in each WAV file (start time in UTC, gain, battery and temperature, from the comment or the GUANO block). The inventory is saved as AudioMoth_<ID>_recordings.csv in the output folder. The audio is not loaded.

Usage

read_audiomoth(
  folder = choose_folder(),
  coordinates = NULL,
  site = NULL,
  precision_m = NULL,
  time_zone = "Europe/Madrid",
  output = NULL,
  copy_to = NULL
)

Arguments

folder

Folder with CONFIG.TXT and the daily folders. By default it is chosen with a dialog (choose_folder()). A copy of the recordings without CONFIG.TXT is also accepted (then coordinates is required).

coordinates

Coordinates of the site in any format accepted by parse_coordinates(). They take priority over those of CONFIG.TXT.

site

Name of the sampling site of this deployment (optional; by default that of the previous deployment when it is in the same place).

precision_m

Precision of the location in metres (the accuracy of Observation.org). By default, the one implied by the number of decimals.

time_zone

Time zone of the local dates and times, as a name of OlsonNames() ("Europe/Madrid", "Atlantic/Canary"...). "UTC+2" is accepted and translated into the fixed zone "Etc/GMT-2".

output

Results folder (it is created if needed). By default it is asked for with choose_output().

copy_to

Copy the card to the disk and work with the copy (see "Copy of the card"): TRUE (into the results folder) or the path of a backup folder. NULL (default): no copy, the card is read where it is.

Value

An object of class audiomoth: a list with folder (the copy when copy_to is used), card_folder (the original card, or NULL), config, location, site and deployment (of this card), time_zone, output, recordings (data frame with one row per WAV file of all the cards of the box, with the deployment, site, lat, lon and precision_m of its deployment) and deployments (one row per card).

Details

Copy of the card (recommended). With copy_to, the card is first copied to the disk and everything is done with the copy: the card can be formatted for the next deployment as soon as the copy is finished, the recordings are kept as a backup, and the steps that go back to the audio (extract_examples(), create_validation(), a new analysis) keep working after the card is gone. Without it, the card is read where it is (it is never modified), and those steps need the card connected at the same path. copy_to = TRUE copies the card into the results folder (<output>/recordings/<first date>-<last date>/); a folder (e.g. on an external disk) copies it into <copy_to>/AudioMoth_<ID>/<first date>-<last date>/, so one backup folder can keep the cards of every box. The copy keeps the structure of the card (CONFIG.TXT and daily folders) and the dates of the files; each file is checked by its size, and files already copied are skipped, so an interrupted copy continues where it stopped. The original folder is kept in the column card_folder of the deployments. Reading the copy again later (with folder) needs no copy_to.

Location of the deployment. Taken from coordinates when given (the recommended way, since the box may have moved); for a card read before, the location it was given then; otherwise from the Location field of CONFIG.TXT, with a warning (it must have been updated in the AudioMoth app when the box was placed, and it only has two decimals, about 700 m). If there is none and the session is interactive, it is asked for in the console (Enter = the site of the previous deployment): just copy and paste the position of a point from Google Earth or Google Maps (see parse_coordinates()). When coordinates and CONFIG.TXT are more than 10 km apart, a warning is given (and an error when latitude and longitude look swapped).

Recordings that are not valid (column problem): unreadable or empty files, interrupted recordings, recordings shorter than 3 s, recordings without a date and duplicated copies of the same recording. Triggered recordings (*T.WAV, amplitude or frequency threshold) are recognised and their real duration, with the silences, is used.

One results folder per box. The output folder gathers all the cards of a box (AudioMoth): each card read is a deployment, with its own dates, site and location, and its recordings are added to those of the cards read before (AudioMoth_<ID>_deployments.csv). BirdNET, the export to Observation.org, the validation and the report then cover the whole period of the box, each recording with the location of its deployment, so a box can be moved between sampling sites. Reading a card again replaces its deployment (and keeps its location unless coordinates are given). The cards of two different boxes cannot share a folder. It is better outside the card, which is usually formatted for the next deployment. When output is not given, it is asked for in the console (see choose_output()), suggesting ~/AudiomothR_results/AudioMoth_<ID> or the folder chosen before for the same box; in a non-interactive session (Rscript) it is the folder remembered for the box or, if there is none, it must be given.

Examples

card <- system.file("extdata", "example", "card", package = "AudiomothR")
am <- read_audiomoth(card, coordinates = "41.00, -3.00", output = tempfile())
#> 
#> ── AudioMoth FACADE0012345678 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> • Folder: /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/AudiomothR/extdata/example/card
#> • Site of this card: AudioMoth FACADE0012345678 (41, -3; ±698 m; source:
#> argument)
#> • Map: <https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=41&mlon=-3#map=15/41/-3>
#> • Recordings: 16 in 2 days (2026-10-07 to 2026-10-15, Europe/Madrid time)
#> • Audio: 48,000 Hz, gain Medium, 0.7 min in total
#> • 10 with problems: duration < 3 s
#> • Battery: 4.9 V → 4.5 V
#> • Temperature: 11.7 to 34.4 °C
#> • Results in: /tmp/RtmpXUCCMs/file23376c5b7946
head(am$recordings[, c("file", "start_local", "duration_s", "valid", "problem")])
#>                                   file         start_local duration_s valid
#> 1 FACADE0012345678_20261007_041500.WAV 2026-10-07 06:15:00       0.05 FALSE
#> 2 FACADE0012345678_20261007_055000.WAV 2026-10-07 07:50:00       0.05 FALSE
#> 3 FACADE0012345678_20261007_064000.WAV 2026-10-07 08:40:09       7.00  TRUE
#> 4 FACADE0012345678_20261007_071500.WAV 2026-10-07 09:15:44       7.00  TRUE
#> 5 FACADE0012345678_20261007_073000.WAV 2026-10-07 09:30:00       0.05 FALSE
#> 6 FACADE0012345678_20261007_080500.WAV 2026-10-07 10:05:04       7.00  TRUE
#>          problem
#> 1 duration < 3 s
#> 2 duration < 3 s
#> 3           <NA>
#> 4           <NA>
#> 5 duration < 3 s
#> 6           <NA>

# Copying the card first into the results folder (recommended with real cards)
out <- tempfile()
am <- read_audiomoth(card, coordinates = "41.00, -3.00", output = out, copy_to = TRUE)
#> Copying the card to
#> /tmp/RtmpXUCCMs/file233764ab2a8d/recordings/20261007-20261015: 17 files (4 MB).
#> ✔ Card copied (17 files): the analysis uses the copy, and the card can be
#>   formatted once you have checked it.
#> 
#> ── AudioMoth FACADE0012345678 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> • Card: /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/AudiomothR/extdata/example/card
#> (copied)
#> • Copy of the card (used from now on):
#> /tmp/RtmpXUCCMs/file233764ab2a8d/recordings/20261007-20261015
#> • Site of this card: AudioMoth FACADE0012345678 (41, -3; ±698 m; source:
#> argument)
#> • Map: <https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=41&mlon=-3#map=15/41/-3>
#> • Recordings: 16 in 2 days (2026-10-07 to 2026-10-15, Europe/Madrid time)
#> • Audio: 48,000 Hz, gain Medium, 0.7 min in total
#> • 10 with problems: duration < 3 s
#> • Battery: 4.9 V → 4.5 V
#> • Temperature: 11.7 to 34.4 °C
#> • Results in: /tmp/RtmpXUCCMs/file233764ab2a8d
am$folder   # the copy: <output>/recordings/20261007-20261015
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpXUCCMs/file233764ab2a8d/recordings/20261007-20261015"
